data.name: Meghnad
data.gender_notes: Meghnad is used as a male name in hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: From the Sanskrit megha, 'cloud', + nāda, 'sound' — 'thunder-voiced'. Its root is Sanskrit megha + nāda. Meghnad (Indrajit), son of Ravana in the Ramayana. Meghnad is a Sanskrit name meaning “Thunder-voiced; a son of Ravana”. Families who choose it generally do so for the quality the name expresses.
data.spiritual_meaning: Meghnad expresses “Thunder-voiced; a son of Ravana”; spiritual readings of the name are interpretive.
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Meghnad total 34, reducing to 7. Number 7 is associated with reflection, analysis and inner search.
